What we talk about

Alignment

How to get AI systems to do what we actually intend.

Interpretability and evaluations

How to understand what a model is doing inside, and test how it behaves.

Ethics and governance

How AI should be built, used, and overseen.

Research, policy, and careers

Where AI safety work happens, and how students get involved in it.
